address: 9/4 Mu 3 Soi Pa Lai, Chao Fa Road, Chalong, Mueang Phuket, Phuket, 83130, Thailand
bio: Mor Mu Dong takes its name from its owner, Mor, and the Mu Dong Canal, where it is located. Nestled in a mangrove forest, it is housed in a set of rustic pavilions where diners can enjoy seafood and take in the views that change with the tide. In the open kitchen, tanks of live seafood affirm the freshness of the food. Order 3–4 vibrant dishes to share and enjoy the Southern Thai flavours bursting from them....
